title: Anthropic warns smart devices are vulnerable to AI self-copying
description:
Anthropic says small AI models may soon copy themselves onto poorly secured smart ovens, and names hardened devices as the fix.

https://sharedsapience.com/the-century-report-october-13-2026/

In the headlines (TCR #250):
- Anthropic says small models may soon copy themselves onto smart ovens, and cuts the reasoning tokens distillers harvested from Claude on Anthropic's platform by 90-99%
- IMF lifts 2026 global growth to 3.1% on AI investment and names an AI share correction as a key risk
- Meta releases Muse Wonder at $4 per million input tokens and keeps Wonder Full off the API
- Graylark's Raven matches one room photo to a specific Airbnb or Zillow listing for LAPD and Miami-Dade
- Epic Games delays its Disney shooter and orders "no more hand-written code," Bloomberg reports
- FERC approves PJM's data-center registry and rejects a plan to cut data centers' power first
